text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian made her comeback. However, 
she had lost the sheer intimidation she 
once possessed. Hishi Amazon was left 
stunned by the sight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking of Narita Brian's frustration 
stirred Hishi Amazon's heart fiercely. 
Afterward, she headed toward the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There was Narita Brian, running alongside 
Symboli Rudolf. Even when left far behind, 
she fiercely clung on with everything she 
had.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian yearns to run just as 
fiercely as ever. Hishi Amazon firmly 
believes that she will rise again without 
fail.
